shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
printf '%s\\n' '--- package scripts ---'
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({scripts:p.scripts,dependencies:p.dependencies},null,2))\"
printf '%s\\n' '--- trace ---'
(lore-query-trace --repo re-cinq/HALEngine --tests_covering src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts || true)
printf '%s\\n' '--- registry ---'
sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- tests ---'
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t "strips a legacy input root from a rejected property path" --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t "strips a legacy input root from a rejected property path" --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t "strips a legacy input root from a rejected property path" --runInBand
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git commit -m "Fix legacy validation property paths"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main
git push origin HEAD
git status --short --branch'
